criteria.requirement: Add exactly three pickable beacon meshes to `beacons`, each a 0.8-radius, 1.5-high cylinder: `left` at `(-6,0.75,2)`, `core` at `(0,0.75,-4)`, and `right` at `(6,0.75,2)`.
criteria.action: Inspect the live scene, beacon IDs, geometry parameters, and world positions after initialization.
criteria.expected: Exactly three cylinders exist with the specified dimensions, IDs, and positions; the ground, emblem torus, and three title bars also exist. (Tolerance: 1e-5 for dimensions and positions)

criteria.requirement: Set `emblem.position` to `(-3,-4+4*a,-20+20*b)` and uniformly scale `titleBars` by `1+0.25*a`.
criteria.action: Call setFrame at 0, 15, 30, and 120 and inspect transforms and getState after each call.
criteria.expected: Emblem positions are (-3,-4,-20), (-3,0,-10), (-3,0,0), and (-3,0,0); title scales are 1, 1.25, 1.25, and 1.25. (Tolerance: 1e-5 per component)

criteria.requirement: In `tour` mode, set camera position to `(0,6,14-7*min(frame/60,1))` and look at the origin.
criteria.action: Reset, then set frames 30, 60, and 120 while remaining in tour mode.
criteria.expected: Camera positions are (0,6,10.5), (0,6,7), and (0,6,7), with cameraTarget (0,0,0) at every frame. (Tolerance: 1e-5 per component)

criteria.requirement: `focusSelected(id)` accepts only `left`, `core`, or `right`; for a valid ID it selects that beacon, changes mode to `focus`, positions the camera at beacon position plus `(0,3,5)`, and looks at the beacon center.
criteria.action: Call focusSelected('core') and inspect selection, highlight, camera transform, and returned state.
criteria.expected: It returns true, selects core, sets mode focus, cameraPosition (0,3.75,1), and cameraTarget (0,0.75,-4); only core is highlighted. (Tolerance: 1e-5 per component)

criteria.requirement: `pickAt(clientX,clientY)` performs the same picking as a canvas click using the renderer canvas bounding rectangle and returns the selected ID or `null`.
criteria.action: Reset, project the right beacon to NDC, convert NDC to canvas client coordinates, call pickAt there, and repeat at an empty canvas corner.
criteria.expected: The beacon-center pick returns right and focuses it; the empty pick returns null without selecting a beacon. (Tolerance: Projection and picked center within 1e-5 NDC; no positional drift)

criteria.requirement: `reset()` restores frame 0, `tour` mode, no selection, all default highlights, the initial camera, and all timeline transforms.
criteria.action: Advance the timeline, focus a beacon, then call reset and inspect the complete public state and materials.
criteria.expected: State returns to frame 0, tour, null selection, camera (0,6,14), target origin, emblem (-3,-4,-20), titleScale 1, and no emissive highlight. (Tolerance: 1e-5 per numeric component)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
